content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Other Production Charges (budget line 000075) is a U.S. Air Force procurement line funded in the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e4e9df975136d796"}}, {"text": "The Miscellaneous Production Charges program covers items not directly related to other procurement line items in the appropriation — end items that cannot reasonably be charged elsewhere, some classified programs, and alternate mission equipment for out-of-production systems.", "citation": {"fact_id": "797e9a7019bb90fa"}}, {"text": "Major efforts supported include Electronic Attack pods and associated test equipment; depot-activation efforts for B-2, F-15E, F-16, and C-5 systems; T-7A depot activation; aerial targets; and the required U.S. contribution to NATO Airborne Early Warning and Control projects.", "citation": {"fact_id": "797e9a7019bb90fa"}}, {"text": "For FY2026, the P-40A C-5 Airlift Squadrons item is a new start, with efforts including funding of the Electronic Warfare Reprogramming Enterprise and the EW/Cyber Combat Assessment via COMBAT SHIELD across multiple combat airframes.", "citation": {"fact_id": "4b9df3ee4bfd97cf"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The line's total funding is $940,190 thousand (about $940 million) requested for FY2026, down from $1,612,819 thousand enacted in FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "44b88a373d009447"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the line recorded actual spending of $1,206,090 thousand (about $1.21 billion), so the FY2026 request falls below both recent years.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e4e9df975136d796"}}, {"text": "The entire FY2026 request is discretionary funding — the P-1 exhibit shows a discretionary request of $940,190 thousand and no separate reconciliation (mandatory) request for this line.", "citation": {"fact_id": "39d55fe69ba4f5b5"}}, {"text": "The line matters because it is a catch-all procurement account that funds cross-cutting Air Force items — from electronic-attack pods to depot activations and the U.S. NATO early-warning contribution — that do not fit neatly into a single weapon-system line.", "citation": {"fact_id": "797e9a7019bb90fa"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The line is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Aircraft Procurement, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "e4e9df975136d796"}}, {"text": "The program is tied to a broad set of Air Force research efforts, with associated Research, Development, Test and Evaluation funding spread across numerous program elements including 0101113F, 0207040F, and 0305116F, among others.", "citation": {"fact_id": "797e9a7019bb90fa"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
